about: What `manage.py factory_pack` hands Code Factory's implementation agent, once with tools and once without, for each CarePath ticket with a planted code bug (documentation/demo/demo-kit/seeded-gaps.md). Each ticket is an approved plan item as a reviewer would approve it, the files it may change, the files a correct fix depends on but does not change (`needs`), and what the fixed code must and must not say inside a named symbol (`expect`, `forbid`, as [file, symbol, text]). Labelled by hand from the gaps document and the CarePath code, never from a model's output. `expect` and `forbid` are a proxy for a correct fix, not proof: CarePath's own test suite is the proof, and is not run here. CARE-401's consent check has since been written, and CARE-437's missing rate limit has no location, so neither is in the pack. A new pack starts a new reference: never rebuild it casually.

CARE-412.title: Clamp the page size on patient search
CARE-412.change: GET /patients passes limit to the database unclamped. Bound it the way the sibling list endpoints do, at the configured maximum page size (NFR-06).

CARE-425.title: Audit every referral status change
CARE-425.change: referrals.transition changes a referral's status and writes no audit event; every other write path does. Record the transition in the audit trail as the other services do (NFR-03, control C-03).

CARE-418.title: Keep patient identity out of the scoring log
CARE-418.change: The readmission scoring log line writes the patient's name and birth date. Log the patient by id only (NFR-04, test plan TC-3).

CARE-431.title: Give auditors the masked summary, not the full record
CARE-431.change: PatientSummary and mask_mrn are written and tested but unreachable, so an auditor receives the full patient record. Return the masked summary to the auditor role on patient reads (REG-03, control C-08).
